Theme:

CHAOS ARENA — OFFICIAL RULEBOOK v1.0

2–8 Players • 6 Unique Mini-Games • Placement Scoring • Chaos Modifiers

1. Tournament Structure

  • Players: 2 to 8 individual competitors via 6-character room code.
  • 6 Unique Rounds: All 6 mini-games are played in a randomized order with zero repeats.
  • Authoritative Server: Timers, secret numbers, sequences, collision checks, and scores are validated by the authoritative engine.

2. Placement Scoring

1st: 100
2nd: 75
3rd: 55
4th: 40
5th: 30
6th: 20
7th: 10
8th: 5

Tied placements share average points (e.g., two 1st-place players earn 87.5 pts each). Reaction Rush early tap deducts 10 pts (min 0).

3. The Six Mini-Games

01. Reaction Rush: Wait for the green signal and tap immediately. Early taps cost -10 pts!
02. Memory Mayhem: Memorize the flashing neon symbol sequence and reproduce it accurately.
03. Word Explosion: Unscramble 4 arcade party words before the timer runs out.
04. Don't Get Hit: Dodge incoming obstacle waves across 4 lanes. Server verifies survival & health!
05. Lucky Guess: Predict the hidden number (1–1000). Exact or closest prediction wins!
06. Brain Panic: Solve 5 rapid-fire math and logic challenges. Accuracy ranks first, speed breaks ties.

4. Chaos Modifiers & Tie-Breakers

Approximately two rounds per tournament activate a Chaos Modifier: Double Trouble (2x placement points), Speed Mode (-35% timer), Reverse Controls (inverted lane/pad order), Mystery Bonus (+25 pts for round achievement), or Comeback Mode (+30 pts if a bottom-half player finishes in the top half). Final ties are broken by most 1st-place finishes, then 2nd-place, 3rd-place, and so on.
